==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
Aviendha emerges from the glass columns on her second trip into Rhuidean. Some of her initial viewings are just faint now, replaced by new ones, some are still in place, such as falling in love with [[Rand al'Thor]]. Aviendha sits beneath Avendesora and contemplates what she saw and what meaning the test will have for the Aiel now that their origins are known to all Aiel. After she rises, Aviendha decides to study the [[Glass columns|Glass column]] ''[[ter'angreal]]'', but backs off after realizing it is beyond her Talents and incomprehensible to a single person. She had felt the column was reading her as much as she was reading it. Deciding to leave Rhuidean, Aviendha steps away from the columns and is taken over by visions.

:{{pov|[[Malidra]]}}
The first vision is seen through the eyes of [[Malidra]], who is a scavenger. She is murdered by a Lightmaker with a [[Lightstick]] for feeding off of their garbage. As she dies the Lightmaker mutters "bloody Aiel".

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
Aviendha is confused about the vision, as it contradicts history. The Aiel in the [[Age of Legends]] were servants, not scavengers. She notices that hours have passed while in the vision. Knowing that she needs to get to the bottom of this mystery she takes another step, looking for more visions.

:{{pov|[[Norlesh]]}}
The second vision is seen through the eyes of [[Norlesh]]. Norlesh and the rest of her family go to those of the Raven Empire and offer them rocks they are seeking. They are turned down as they are required not to trade with Aiel or risk losing their charter allowing them to mine in the area. As Norlash sits down with her family dejected, she realizes her infant [[Garlvan]] has died during the walk.

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
Aviendha is beside herself with grief. The Aiel without honor, reduced to a begging broken race. Aviendha steels herself and takes another step.

:{{pov|[[Tava]]}}
The third vision is seen through the eyes of [[Tava]]. She is part of a group of Aiel being attacked in a hold, by ''[[Raken]]'' with Seanchan using Lightsticks (assumed to be a sort of musket). The Aiel are mostly destroyed and abandon the hold.

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
Aviendha finally realizes this is not the past like she had assumed, but the future. One where the [[Seanchan]] have utterly and comprehensively defeated the Aiel in war. Sobbing she steps forward.
